test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 Nov, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required.’

I decided to __call out__ to various bookstores in the area to see if any of them had the book I needed.
solution:
The correct option that can substitute the underlined segment in the sentence is ‘1’ i.e. call around.
